description: List the path rules on one mapping job, by the job's `id`: the overrides a person set on particular branches. Each rule has a path ("root" or DTMF digits such as "3:2"), state (exclude: never explore this branch; remap: map it again on the next run), config (scripted input for that point, such as a PIN or a spoken reply), repeat settings and when and by whom it was set; plus totalRules. A job with no rules returns an empty list. Use when: the user asks why a branch was not mapped, or what the mapper says at a prompt. Read-only. Needs mapping:read. Returns 404 if the job is not in your workspace.
name: listMappingPathRules

outputSchema.description: Response from `GET /mapping/{id}/paths`. Lists all path-rule overrides.

items.description:
A path-specific behaviour override on a mapping job. No rule = path uses default
("fixed") behaviour. `state: remap` flags the path for re-discovery on next run;
`state: exclude` skips it. `config` provides scripted input for the path (PINs,
voice utterances, profile data).

config.description: Scripted input configuration for a specific path (PIN entry, voice utterance, etc.).

data.description: Input payload — PIN digits, voice utterance, S3 URL for audio, etc.

inputType.description: Type of scripted input to apply when navigating this path.

waitForPrompt.description: Whether to wait for the prompt before sending input.

markedAt.description: When the rule was created or last modified.

menuDurationMs.description: Cached menu duration in ms (used for replay timing).

path.description:
Path string. Either `root` (for the entry point) or colon-separated DTMF digits
(e.g. `3:2:1` reaches the third option, then the second, then the first).

repeatConfig.description:
Repeat-detection configuration. Controls how the orchestrator handles
situations where a discovered menu is revisited via a different DTMF path
(a loop). `skip` ignores the revisit entirely; `explore_once` explores it
the first time only; `explore_n` explores up to `maxExplorations` times.

behavior.description: Behaviour when a repeated menu is detected.

state.description:
`remap` — schedule this path for re-discovery on the next run (deletes child steps).
`exclude` — skip this path on the next run.

title: List Mapping Path Rules
